paragraphs.text: Kastral is a legendary birdfolk scout from Bloomburrow .

Kastral is a bluejay birdfolk from Bloomburrow. She dons a distinguished vest, a flowing cape, and a pair of binoculars, and carries an elaborate artifact adorned with golden loops and gray ribbons. Adding to her unique look is a long twig strapped to her head, giving her an almost whimsical resemblance to a peculiar unicorn.

As a member of the Windcrested , Kastral has flown to the Tip of the World and completed the Plumecreed . She wears a colored feather on her head as a sign of this accomplishment. Kastral is an elite squad leader who dedicates herself to helping the lost.

Kastral is known for returning from her Plumecreed journey seven seasons after her funeral, surprising everyone, including herself. She revealed she'd been lost after a strange, massive lightning storm suddenly appeared and sent her far off her path with a broken wing. Kastral recounted how she'd gotten help from folk she'd never seen before and had to run away from Calamity Beasts she'd never heard of. While her friends and family were overjoyed that she was alive, the once easygoing Kastral returned changed — faster than other Windcrested and more attuned to the winds than ever before. Folks have always speculated whether the Plumecreed journey itself makes the Windcrested and theorizes Kastral's abilities are from surviving a journey more perilous than animalfolk can imagine. Kastral doesn't mind either way, believing that her powers are born from misfortune and that no one should ever feel as hopeless and lost as she once did.
